parts.name: V1
parts.lyrics:
Who am I that the highest King
Would welcome me?
I was lost, but He brought me in
Oh, His love for me
Oh, His love for me

parts.name: C1
parts.lyrics:
Who the Son sets free
Oh, is free indeed
I'm a child of God, yes, I am

parts.name: V2
parts.lyrics:
Free at last, He has ransomed me
His grace runs deep
While I was a slave to sin
Jesus died for me
Yes, He died for me

parts.name: C2
parts.lyrics:
In my Father's house
There's a place for me
I'm a child of God, yes, I am

parts.name: B
parts.lyrics:
I am chosen, not forsaken
I am who You say I am
You are for me, not against me
I am who You say I am

parts.name: T
parts.lyrics: Oh I am who You say I am
